decisions.reason: A burner component for radiant heaters supports the firm's core gas infrared business and its installed base, so it is cheap to keep and useful for service.
The electric infrared panel line is a flagship and fits the shift toward electrified, lower-carbon heating that the market is moving to.
The halogen infrared heater serves niche outdoor and spot-heating uses at low cost, so dropping it within a year is unlikely, even though it is less central than the other products.
The industrial electric hall heater line is close to the firm's core hall-heating business and meets growing demand for electric alternatives.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world pilot and matches the firm's hydrogen-ready direction.
